theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (L : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (K m : ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (R M r : ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a ∧ J a ≤ K) → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖F a - F b‖) → (∀ c, m * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖L c‖) → Continuous f → (∀ w, R ≤ ‖w‖ → f w = 0) → (∀ w, ‖f w‖ ≤ M) → 0 < r → ‖(∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume) - J b * (∫ c, f (L c) ∂volume)‖ ≤ K * M * (∫ c in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) (R / m), Bᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (b + r • c) ∂volume) + M * (∫ c in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) (R / m), ‖J (b + r • c) - J b‖ ∂volume) + J b * (∫ c in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) (R / m), ‖f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) - f (L c)‖ ∂volume)
